name: Blockchair (API and explorer pages)
tier_rationale: Established company with published terms, a privacy policy and a business offering (A8). 'Registry tiers: Blockstream, Blockchain.com, BlockCypher and Blockchair trusted' (P211 cond 6); 'trusted - Blockchain.com, Blockchair' (P216 cond 5).

reliability.justification: Explorer API serving chain data indexed from its own full nodes (40+ chains): balances and histories are chain facts; freshness depends on its indexer.

error_markers.reason: Blockchair: egress IP temporarily blacklisted (HTTP 430): rate limited, could not verify

blockchair.description: Blockchair API key (commercial plan; keyless use is personal/non-commercial)
blockchair.plan_hint: business = a commercial Blockchair API plan held by the company (P211 cond 2); keyless and free use are personal/non-commercial, so the API stays off under the corporate profile without it

api.title: Blockchair API (address dashboards on 40+ chains)

terms.quote: Per-adapter terms recorded: Esplora, mempool, litecoinspace and Blockchain.com 'open'; BlockCypher and Blockchair 'key-terms'.

api.notes: free_plan_business_use false: 'Blockchair only with a commercial key 'blockchair' (keyless use is personal/non-commercial, and our egress got HTTP 430 on the second call)' (P211 cond 2), so under corporate it runs only with key_plans.blockchair='business'. Research C0482 terms 'Blockchair API terms; keyless use limited, non-commercial free tier on request.' The API docs link the terms of service (https://blockchair.com/terms) and the plans page. Endpoint https://api.blockchair.com/{chain}/dashboards/address/{address}?limit=10. Used by btc_explorers.
api.licensed_alternative: A commercial Blockchair API plan recorded as key_plans.blockchair='business' (P211 cond 2); the Esplora, mempool.space and Blockchain.com adapters ('open') keep BTC coverage.

explorer_pages.title: Blockchair explorer address pages (manual pivot links)

terms.quote: The pack is offline data (disclosure 'none'): V3LUM never requests these URLs or any API behind them.

explorer_pages.notes: Manual pivot links only (data/pivot_links/crypto.json): blockchair.com/{chain}/address/{address}; research C0508 terms 'Blockchair ToS.' Used by pivots_crypto.

notes: Seeded once for batches p2-G09-2 and p2-G14-2 (P211, P216). Keyless egress got HTTP 430 'IP temporary blacklisted ... apply for an API key' on the second call (research C0482): the marker maps it to RATE_LIMITED as P211 cond 4 requires (the core classifier alone reads 430 as blocked/challenge) and the host is short-circuited for the run, hence retries 0. Plan limits depend on the commercial plan bought: no quota block until it is recorded (per-host P334 bucket).
